summary: Object constructor with SEH and vtable chain setup. Registers the frame SEH handler, saves the ecx-passed this pointer (v3) to the frame, then only when the guard field at this+0xC is non-zero applies the base vtable chain: *v3 = unk_5B9C54, v3[10] = 0, v3[1] = basic_ios vftable, and sets frame completion flags. Regardless of the guard, writes the basic_ostream vftable at this + *(*(this)+4) (the multi-inheritance vtable-adjustment offset), then calls sub_59A8FA on that adjusted pointer and returns this.
